title: coland interop: keyMaterial accepts native Arkret Station claims only; user seeding needs coauth
description:
Side: coland.

keyMaterial on coland is native-only. verify_mimi_key_material_source_signature sets native_claim=true, which requires Provider-ID == Source-Service-ID (a core id, not mimi://), plus Idempotency-Key, Source-Trust-Domain and Destination-Trust-Domain. The body must carry an Arkret device-authorized requester_authorization and must require the capability "mimi.content.v1" with last_resort_allowed != true. A non-Arkret MIMI provider therefore cannot claim KeyPackages from coland, even if it signs requests.
Seeding a target user with KeyPackages needs an Arkret account and device. Creating one needs a coauth Account Authority (COLAND_ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_URL plus session-grant introspection), or a conformance-harness build in development mode. This deployment has neither, so no user was seeded.
Code: crates/http/src/routing/interop/mimi/handlers.rs mimi_key_material; crates/http/src/routing/mls.rs mimi_claim_keypackage / peer_claim_keypackage_with_room.
